must_have.title: Investor deck request + timed hosted deck viewer
must_have.description: Founder-in-loop deck flow: /investors 'Request the deck' opens a bilingual form (name, firm/fund, work email required; LinkedIn/website + message optional; honeypot) → rate-limited POST /api/deck-request → Resend alert to the team with the requester's details and three mint options (primary 'Generate 1-hour deck link' button; plain text links for a non-expiring link and a custom-hours link) → founder-only /deck-admin page gated by DECK_SECRET mints stateless HMAC-signed tokens → /deck?token= renders the private pitch deck (private/deck/mobeeli-pitchdeck.pdf, never under public/) on pdfjs canvases with no download UI, streaming bytes from token-gated /api/deck-file; expired links show a bilingual re-request page. Email-only — no database writes.
acceptance_criteria: Request form validates and alerts the team with the three mint options (1-hour primary button, non-expiring + custom-hours text links)
/deck-admin 404s without the correct DECK_SECRET; presets auto-generate; custom hours input works; links shown with expiry + copy button
Tokens are tamper-proof HMAC with exp|null enforced server-side on /deck and /api/deck-file (403 without valid token)
Viewer renders all deck pages on canvases with no native PDF toolbar or download button; deck routes are noindex and not in the sitemap
Expired links show the bilingual 'link has expired' page pointing to /investors
